roadmap.title: Found a city and start long counters
roadmap.description: Create a city, learn the tools and keep the day/night cycle running during later projects.

roadmap.title: Grow a stable city
roadmap.description: Grow a functioning city, expand services and transport, and work toward monuments. Save before experiments that damage the city.

roadmap.title: Winter, disasters and scenarios
roadmap.description: Develop a winter city, try disasters on a separate save and complete scenarios.

roadmap.title: Transit, green districts and parks
roadmap.description: Expand transport, build green districts and develop parks.

roadmap.title: Industry, campuses and fishing
roadmap.description: Build industrial areas and campuses, then develop fishing and new transport services.

roadmap.title: Airports, pedestrian areas and finances
roadmap.description: Develop an airport and pedestrian areas, then complete financial projects.

roadmap.title: Hotels and Race Day events
roadmap.description: Develop successful hotels and host races and parades.

achievements.description: Create your very first city
achievements.summary: Found your first city.

steps.text: Start a new game, create a city and save.

achievements.description: Use the Asset Editor to make your very own asset
achievements.summary: Create and save an asset in the Asset Editor.

steps.text: Open Tools > Asset Editor from the main menu, edit an asset and save it.

achievements.description: Create a map
achievements.summary: Create and save a map in the Map Editor.

steps.text: Open Tools > Map Editor from the main menu, create a map and save it.

achievements.description: Have a look at all the different info-view panels
achievements.summary: Open every available info-view panel.

steps.text: Open the info views at the upper left and select every panel, including panels added by your installed expansions.

achievements.description: Use the district tool to draw 3 districts
achievements.summary: Draw three districts with the district tool.

steps.text: Use the district brush to paint three separate districts.

achievements.description: Apply a policy to a district you created
achievements.summary: Enable a policy in a district you created.

steps.text: Select one of your districts and enable a policy for that district.

achievements.description: Unlock all city services
achievements.summary: Make every city service available.

steps.text: Grow the city through population milestones until electricity, water, garbage, healthcare, police, fire and parks services are all unlocked.

achievements.description: Unlock Monuments
achievements.summary: Make monuments available for construction.

steps.text: Reach the final population milestone to open the Monuments menu.

achievements.description: Build the Medical Center Monument
achievements.summary: Construct the Medical Center monument.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before changing the city.
Lazaret Plaza — keep average health below 20% for 3 weeks.
Mall of Moderation — reach an average garbage accumulation of at least 25 per building.
Court House — keep crime above 50% for 5 weeks.
Oppression Office — keep unemployment above 50% for 5 weeks.
High Interest Tower — reach ₡2,000 in debt.
Sea-and-Sky Scraper — construct a Harbor and a Cargo Harbor.
Construct all six required unique buildings, then build the @item{Medical Center} from the Monuments menu.
Reload the manual save after the achievement unlocks to restore the city.

achievements.description: Build the Hadron Collider Monument
achievements.summary: Construct the Hadron Collider monument.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before changing the city.
Statue of Shopping — let the treasury fall below zero.
Posh Mall — keep every tax rate below 4% for 20 weeks.
Colossal Order Offices — spend more than ₡20,000 per week on education for 10 weeks.
Grand Library — maintain 7 universities for 10 weeks.
Aquarium — enroll 5,000 children in elementary schools.
Theater of Wonders — place elementary schools, high schools and universities, with 3 of each.
Construct all six required unique buildings, then build the @item{Hadron Collider} from the Monuments menu.
Reload the manual save after the achievement unlocks to restore the city.

achievements.description: Build the Space Elevator Monument
achievements.summary: Construct the Space Elevator monument.

steps.text: Statue of Wealth — accumulate ₡500,000.
Transport Tower — carry 1,000 public transport passengers per week.
Grand Mall — construct an Airport.
Opera House — extract natural resources until its unlock counter is complete.
Expo Center — attract tourists until the building's displayed tourist unlock counter reaches 2,000.
Stadium — produce 1,000 units of goods.
Construct all six required unique buildings, then build the @item{Space Elevator} from the Monuments menu.

achievements.description: Build the Eden Project Monument
achievements.summary: Construct the Eden Project monument.

steps.text: Statue of Industry — develop 10,000 squares of industrial zoning.
Friendly Neighborhood Park — develop 10,000 squares of residential zoning.
Official Park — develop 10,000 squares of office zoning.
Business Park — develop 20,000 squares of commercial zoning.
Servicing Services Office — construct 300 city service buildings.
Cathedral of Plentitude — construct the 30 different city service buildings required by its unlock panel. Parks and unique buildings do not count.
Construct all six required unique buildings, then build the @item{Eden Project} from the Monuments menu.

achievements.description: Build the Fusion Power Plant Monument
achievements.summary: Construct the Fusion Power Plant monument.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before changing the city.
Plaza of the Dead — fill 3 cemeteries.
Fountain of Life and Death — have one citizen live an entire lifespan in the city.
Tax Office — construct a Water Treatment Plant and 3 Water Pumping Stations, and generate 1,000 MW of electricity.
Observatory — keep 1,000 abandoned buildings for 5 weeks.
Science Center — have 5,000 citizens live their entire lifespans in the city.
MAM Modern Art Museum — reach 50% highly educated residents.
Construct all six required unique buildings, then build the @item{Fusion Power Plant} from the Monuments menu.
Reload the manual save after the achievement unlocks to restore the city.

achievements.description: Unlock every single building in the game
achievements.summary: Unlock every building in the game.

steps.text: For a base-game run, disable optional expansions before starting the city.
Complete the five monument projects: Medical Center, Hadron Collider, Space Elevator, Eden Project and Fusion Power Plant.
Open the locked entries in Unique Buildings and complete each displayed requirement. Include these landmark projects:
Statue of Liberty — produce 5,000 units of industrial goods.
Arc de Triomphe — enroll 15,000 children in elementary schools.
Brandenburg Gate — have 10,000 citizens complete their entire lifespans in the city: born, raised and deceased there.
Eiffel Tower — develop 30,000 squares of industrial zoning. Office and commercial zoning do not count.
Grand Central Terminal — fill seven cemeteries.
Work through the remaining service, transport and parks menus. Build the available entries and finish any locked entries shown there.
Save a separate copy before destructive unlock conditions. Construct newly unlocked buildings before undoing their conditions, then reload the safe copy after the experiment.

achievements.description: Have a population of 100,000 in your city
achievements.summary: Grow one city to 100,000 residents.

steps.text: Expand residential zoning, jobs and city services until the population reaches 100,000.

achievements.description: Have more than 10 districts with unique policies
achievements.summary: Have more than ten districts, each with a different policy.

steps.text: Paint 11 separate districts and give each district a different policy.

achievements.description: Have 20 transport lines
achievements.summary: Have 20 public transport lines.

steps.text: Create 20 public transport lines; bus lines count, so metro construction is optional.

achievements.description: Have 50 transport lines
achievements.summary: Have 50 public transport lines.

steps.text: Add public transport lines until the city has 50 lines. Bus lines can be used.

achievements.description: Have a Citizen educated to level 3 from 0
achievements.summary: Educate one resident from level 0 through level 3.

steps.text: Provide elementary schools, high schools and a university, then let an initially uneducated resident complete university.

achievements.description: Have 15% happiness
achievements.summary: Reduce city happiness to 15%.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before changing the city.
Withdraw city services and let happiness fall to 15%.
Reload the manual save after the achievement unlocks to restore the city.

achievements.description: Earn 15,000 per week
achievements.summary: Reach weekly earnings of ₡15,000.

steps.text: Grow the tax base and limit service spending until weekly income reaches ₡15,000.

achievements.description: Click on a police building 100 times in a row
achievements.summary: Select the same police building 100 times consecutively.

steps.text: Click one police building 100 times without selecting another building.

achievements.description: Have more than 95% city happiness for 5 years
achievements.summary: Keep city happiness above 95% for five consecutive in-game years.

steps.text: Provide enough services and parks to raise city happiness above 95%.
Keep happiness above 95% for five in-game years. If happiness falls to 95% or lower, raise happiness and restart the five-year run.

achievements.description: Have the city survive a crime rate of over 40% for 2 years
achievements.summary: Keep the city alive with crime above 40% for two consecutive in-game years.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before changing the city.
Remove police coverage and wait until the crime rate rises above 40%.
Keep the city running above 40% crime for two in-game years.
Reload the manual save after the achievement unlocks to restore the city.

achievements.description: Have 5 Fire Stations
achievements.summary: Have five Fire Stations in one city.

steps.text: Construct five @item{Fire Stations}.

achievements.description: Have 5 Police Headquarters
achievements.summary: Have five Police Headquarters in one city.

steps.text: Construct five @item{Police Headquarters}; the smaller Police Stations do not satisfy this requirement.

achievements.description: Fill five landfill sites
achievements.summary: Completely fill five landfill sites.

steps.text: Keep five landfill sites collecting garbage until all five are full. Avoid using incinerators while filling them.

achievements.description: No water or ground pollution in a city of over 10,000 residents
achievements.summary: Reach zero water and ground pollution in a city with more than 10,000 residents.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before changing the city.
Keep the population above 10,000, remove or close polluting facilities and replace sewage outlets with Water Treatment Plants.
Wait until both ground and water pollution read 0%.
Reload the manual save after the achievement unlocks to restore the city.

achievements.description: Have over 70% of citizens highly educated in a city of over 10,000 people
achievements.summary: Have more than 70% highly educated residents in a city with more than 10,000 people.

steps.text: Provide enough elementary schools, high schools and universities for residential areas. Enable Education Boost.
Keep population above 10,000 and allow graduates to raise the highly educated share above 70%. The Hadron Collider can also raise education.

achievements.description: Have an area the size of nine map tiles
achievements.summary: Own nine map tiles in one city.

steps.text: Reach the final milestone, then buy available tiles until your city owns nine tiles.

achievements.description: Keep the crime rate under 10% for 4 years straight
achievements.summary: Keep crime below 10% for four consecutive in-game years.

steps.text: Provide police coverage throughout the city and keep crime below 10% for four in-game years. If crime reaches 10%, lower crime and restart the four-year run.

achievements.description: Have the industry tax rate over 5% higher than either residential tax rate for one year
achievements.summary: Keep the industrial tax rate more than five percentage points above at least one residential tax rate for one in-game year.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before changing the city.
Set industrial tax to 13% and one residential tax rate to 7%.
Maintain that six-point difference for one in-game year.
Reload the manual save after the achievement unlocks to restore the city.

achievements.description: Have both residential tax rates over 5% higher than industry for one year
achievements.summary: Keep both residential tax rates more than five percentage points above industrial tax for one in-game year.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before changing the city.
Set low-density residential tax to 12%, high-density residential tax to 13% and industrial tax to 6%.
Maintain these rates for one in-game year.
Reload the manual save after the achievement unlocks to restore the city.

achievements.description: Have 1000 squares of leisure specialized commercial zone
achievements.summary: Develop 1,000 squares of leisure-specialized commercial zoning.

steps.text: Paint a district over commercial zoning and apply the Leisure specialization. Let businesses occupy at least 1,000 squares.

achievements.description: Have 1000 squares of beach specialized commercial zone
achievements.summary: Develop 1,000 squares of tourism-specialized commercial zoning.

steps.text: Paint a district over commercial zoning and apply the Tourism specialization. Let businesses occupy at least 1,000 squares.

achievements.description: Have 15 Prisons in the city
achievements.summary: Have 15 prisons in one city.

steps.text: Construct 15 @item{Prisons} in the same city.

achievements.description: Experience 1001 nights in the game
achievements.summary: Let 1,001 nights pass in the game.

steps.text: Keep the day/night cycle enabled while completing the other achievements.
If more nights are needed, run an empty city at maximum simulation speed until the counter reaches 1,001 nights.

achievements.displayName: Does My Bum Look Big In This?
achievements.description: Change Chirper look
achievements.summary: Change Chirper to a different appearance.

steps.text: Open Chirper settings and select a different appearance.

achievements.description: Experience rain
achievements.summary: Have a city experience rain.

steps.text: Enable dynamic weather on a non-winter map and let the city run until rain begins.

achievements.description: Experience fog
achievements.summary: Have a city experience fog.

steps.text: Enable dynamic weather on a non-winter map and let the city run until fog appears.

achievements.description: Create a winter map in map editor
achievements.summary: Create a winter-themed map in the Map Editor.

steps.text: Open Tools > Map Editor, choose the Winter theme, create a map and save it.

achievements.description: Experience snowfall
achievements.summary: Have a city experience snowfall.

steps.text: Start a city on a Winter map with weather enabled and let the simulation run until snow falls.

achievements.description: Have one tram line active
achievements.summary: Have one tram line operating in one city.

steps.text: Build a tram depot and connected tram roads. Place stops and finish a tram line that returns to its starting stop.

achievements.description: Have 10 tram lines active
achievements.summary: Have ten tram lines operating in one city.

steps.text: Use the connected tram roads and depot to create ten active tram lines. Multiple lines can share the same loop.

achievements.description: Have a Sauna in the city
achievements.summary: Have a sauna in the city.

steps.text: Construct a @item{Sauna} from the healthcare menu.

achievements.description: Change Chirper to a winter look
achievements.summary: Give Chirper a winter appearance.

steps.text: Open Chirper’s appearance settings and choose the bird wearing a winter hat.

achievements.description: Boost 100 km of streets with Road maintenance service
achievements.summary: Have the Road Maintenance Service improve 100 km of roads.

steps.text: Build a @item{Road Maintenance Depot} with road access and let its trucks maintain the city’s roads until they have covered 100 km.

achievements.description: Have snowplows collect 2000000 units of snow
achievements.summary: Clear 2,000,000 units of snow with snowplows.

steps.text: On a winter map, build a @item{Snow Dump} connected to the road network. Keep snowplows working until their collected snow reaches 2,000,000 units.

achievements.description: Build one quay
achievements.summary: Construct a quay.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Landscaping → Water Structures} to place a quay along the water.

achievements.description: Build one canal
achievements.summary: Construct a canal.

steps.text: Place a canal segment from @mechanic{Landscaping → Water Structures}.

achievements.description: Experience a tsunami
achievements.summary: Experience a tsunami in a city.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before starting the disaster.
Choose a coastal map so the tsunami has open water to cross.
In @mechanic{Landscaping → Disasters}, select @mechanic{Tsunami}, place the disaster and let the simulation run until the tsunami occurs.
After the achievement unlocks, reload the manual save to restore the city.

achievements.description: Experience an earthquake
achievements.summary: Experience an earthquake in a city.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before starting the disaster.
In @mechanic{Landscaping → Disasters}, select @mechanic{Earthquake}, place the disaster and let the simulation run until the earthquake occurs.
After the achievement unlocks, reload the manual save to restore the city.

achievements.description: Experience a meteor strike
achievements.summary: Experience a meteor strike in a city.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before starting the disaster.
In @mechanic{Landscaping → Disasters}, select @mechanic{Meteor Strike}, place the disaster and let the simulation run until the meteor strike occurs.
After the achievement unlocks, reload the manual save to restore the city.

achievements.description: Experience a sinkhole
achievements.summary: Experience a sinkhole in a city.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before starting the disaster.
In @mechanic{Landscaping → Disasters}, select @mechanic{Sinkhole}, place the disaster and let the simulation run until the sinkhole occurs.
After the achievement unlocks, reload the manual save to restore the city.

achievements.description: Experience a forest fire
achievements.summary: Experience a forest fire in a city.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before starting the disaster.
Choose a wooded area for the fire.
In @mechanic{Landscaping → Disasters}, select @mechanic{Forest Fire}, place the disaster and let the simulation run until the forest fire occurs.
After the achievement unlocks, reload the manual save to restore the city.

achievements.description: Experience a thunderstorm
achievements.summary: Experience a thunderstorm in a city.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before starting the disaster.
In @mechanic{Landscaping → Disasters}, select @mechanic{Thunderstorm}, place the disaster and let the simulation run until the thunderstorm occurs.
After the achievement unlocks, reload the manual save to restore the city.

achievements.description: Experience a tornado
achievements.summary: Experience a tornado in a city.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before starting the disaster.
In @mechanic{Landscaping → Disasters}, select @mechanic{Tornado}, place the disaster and let the simulation run until the tornado occurs.
After the achievement unlocks, reload the manual save to restore the city.

achievements.description: Experience a special disaster
achievements.summary: Experience a Chirpnado in a city.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before enabling random disasters.
Turn on random disasters in the gameplay settings and raise their frequency. Keep a functioning city running until the rare blue Chirper tornado appears.
Reload the manual save afterward to restore the city.

achievements.description: Have ten disasters hit the same city
achievements.summary: Have ten disasters strike one city.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save of the city.
Use @mechanic{Landscaping → Disasters} to start ten disasters in that same city. Let each event occur before counting the next.
Reload the manual save after the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Create 10 scenarios
achievements.summary: Create ten scenarios.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{Scenario Editor} and choose a map.
Give the scenario at least one win condition and one loss condition. Save the scenario under its own name.
Create and save nine more scenarios with different names.

achievements.description: Win 10 scenarios
achievements.summary: Win ten scenarios.

steps.text: Create ten separately named scenarios in the @mechanic{Scenario Editor}, each with a win condition and a loss condition. Use short goals that the city can meet.
Play each scenario and satisfy its win condition. If a scenario fails, replay that scenario.

achievements.description: Lose 10 scenarios
achievements.summary: Lose ten scenarios.

steps.text: Create ten separately named scenarios with both win and loss conditions. Set a loss condition the starting city can quickly meet.
Play each scenario and trigger its loss condition. Replay any scenario that ends in a win.

achievements.description: Have 3 ferry lines
achievements.summary: Have 3 ferry lines operating in one city.

steps.text: Build a @item{Ferry Depot} and ferry stops, then join the stops with ferry pathways.
Use the ferry line tool to create 3 complete routes. Keep the lines in place together.

achievements.description: Have 15 ferry lines
achievements.summary: Have 15 ferry lines operating in one city.

steps.text: Build a @item{Ferry Depot} and ferry stops, then join the stops with ferry pathways.
Use the ferry line tool to create 15 complete routes. Keep the lines in place together.

achievements.description: Have 3 monorail lines
achievements.summary: Have 3 monorail lines operating in one city.

steps.text: Build monorail stations and connect them with monorail tracks.
Use the monorail line tool to create 3 complete routes. Keep the lines in place together.

achievements.description: Have 10 monorail lines
achievements.summary: Have 10 monorail lines operating in one city.

steps.text: Build monorail stations and connect them with monorail tracks.
Use the monorail line tool to create 10 complete routes. Keep the lines in place together.

achievements.description: Transport 5 000 passengers with Cable Cars
achievements.summary: Carry 5,000 passengers on cable cars.

steps.text: Build cable car stops and connect them with cable. Put the stops where residents can use them to reach busy parks or commercial areas.
Keep the cable cars operating until their passenger total reaches 5,000.

achievements.description: Transport 20 000 passengers with Cable Cars
achievements.summary: Carry 20,000 passengers on cable cars.

steps.text: Build cable car stops and connect them with cable. Put the stops where residents can use them to reach busy parks or commercial areas.
Keep the cable cars operating until their passenger total reaches 20,000.

achievements.description: Have 3 blimp lines
achievements.summary: Have 3 blimp lines operating in one city.

steps.text: Build a @item{Blimp Depot} and blimp stops, then connect them with blimp pathways.
Use the blimp line tool to create 3 complete routes. Keep the lines in place together.

achievements.displayName: Put Some Blimp In Your Blimp
achievements.description: Have 10 blimp lines
achievements.summary: Have 10 blimp lines operating in one city.

steps.text: Build a @item{Blimp Depot} and blimp stops, then connect them with blimp pathways.
Use the blimp line tool to create 10 complete routes. Keep the lines in place together.

achievements.description: Have one Ferry and Bus Exchange Stop, Metro-Monorail-Train Hub, Monorail-Bus Hub and Multiplatform Train Station
achievements.summary: Have a ferry–bus exchange stop, a monorail–bus hub, a metro–monorail–train hub and a multiplatform train station in one city.

steps.text: Place a @item{Multiplatform Train Station} and a @item{Monorail-Bus Hub}. Add a @item{Ferry and Bus Exchange Stop} and a @item{Metro-Monorail-Train Hub} to the same city.

achievements.description: Name a road
achievements.summary: Assign a custom name to a road.

steps.text: Select a road and replace its name in the road information panel.

achievements.description: Name 100 roads
achievements.summary: Give custom names to 100 roads.

steps.text: Select and rename 100 different roads through their road information panels.

achievements.description: Name a road "Steve"
achievements.summary: Name a road “Steve”.

steps.text: Select a road and enter @mechanic{Steve} as its name, with that spelling.

achievements.description: Win all three Mass Transit scenarios
achievements.summary: Win the three scenarios included with Mass Transit.

steps.text: Win @mechanic{Fix the Traffic}: keep traffic flow above 82% and raise population above 35,000. Pause first to improve congested roads. Avoid dropping below 25,000 residents or reaching 200 game weeks.
Win @mechanic{Ferry Empire}: transport 250,000 passengers by ship and grow beyond 25,000 residents. Use ferries and the free public transport policy. Keep the treasury at or above zero.

Win @mechanic{Trains!}: construct 210 train-track sections and carry 200,000 train passengers. Keep the treasury at or above zero. Reach at least 1,000 residents by 20 game weeks and 12,000 by 150 game weeks.
Replay any failed scenario until each of the three has a recorded win.

achievements.description: Check a route of a citizen
achievements.summary: Inspect a citizen’s travel route.

steps.text: Select a citizen, then click the @mechanic{Route} icon in the citizen information panel.

achievements.description: Have all residential zone in your city be specialized Self-Sufficient Housing
achievements.summary: Specialize every residential zone in the city as Self-Sufficient Housing.

guide.context: Changing the specialization of an existing district causes the affected buildings to rebuild.

steps.text: Cover every residential zone with districts and apply @mechanic{Self-Sufficient Housing} to each district. Allow at least one residential building to develop.

achievements.description: Have all office zone in your city be specialized IT-Cluster
achievements.summary: Specialize every office zone in the city as IT-Cluster.

guide.context: Changing the specialization of an existing district causes the affected buildings to rebuild.

steps.text: Cover every office zone with districts and apply @mechanic{IT-Cluster} to each district. Allow at least one office building to develop.

achievements.description: Have all commercial zone in your city be specialized Organic and Local Produce
achievements.summary: Specialize every commercial zone in the city as Organic and Local Produce.

guide.context: Changing the specialization of an existing district causes the affected buildings to rebuild.

steps.text: Cover every commercial zone with districts and apply @mechanic{Organic and Local Produce} to each district. Allow at least one commercial building to develop.

achievements.description: Produce all electricity without using raw materials
achievements.summary: Generate the city’s entire electricity supply without fuel or other raw materials.

steps.text: Start a new city, place a road and use a wind turbine as the city’s only electricity generator.

achievements.description: Build one of each eco-friendly schools: Community School, Institute of Creative Arts and Modern Technology Institute
achievements.summary: Build the three Green Cities eco-friendly schools.

steps.text: Place a @item{Modern Technology Institute} and a @item{Community School}. Add an @item{Institute of Creative Arts} in the same city.

achievements.description: Have no polluting industry in your city, only Office Zone and specialized zones
achievements.summary: Have a city whose industrial zones contain no polluting industry.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before removing industry from an existing city.
Remove generic polluting industry. Use office zones and nonpolluting industrial specializations instead, or remove industrial zoning entirely.
After the achievement unlocks, reload the manual save if you want to restore the removed industry.

achievements.displayName: The Park To Rule All Parks
achievements.description: Have a maximum level park made with Park Tool
achievements.summary: Raise a park area to level 5.

steps.text: Paint a park area and build its main gate with a road connection.
Add park attractions and connect them to the gate with paths. Use the park information panel to check entertainment and visitor targets.
Add newly unlocked attractions as the park levels up, then keep attracting visitors until the park reaches level 5.

achievements.description: Have 10 parks made with Park Tool
achievements.summary: Create ten park areas with the Park Tool.

steps.text: Use the @mechanic{Park Tool} to paint ten separate park areas. Add a main gate to each area.

achievements.description: Have a park with all zoo buildings built in it
achievements.summary: Build every zoo building within one park area.

steps.text: Paint one zoo area and place its main gate. Connect the gate to a road and the park buildings to paths.
Include a shoreline within the park boundary so water-based attractions can be placed.
Develop the zoo to level 5 by meeting the visitor and entertainment targets shown in its information panel.

In the @mechanic{Zoo} building tab, place every park building inside that same area, including the side gate. The required buildings end before the decorative benches; props are unnecessary. Place the @item{Sea Life Enclosure} on the shoreline.

achievements.description: Have 5 pedestrian Walking Tour lines
achievements.summary: Have five pedestrian Walking Tour lines.

steps.text: Place Walking Tour stops along walkable paths, then connect the stops into five complete @mechanic{Walking Tour} lines.

achievements.description: Have a Park Maintenance Service and a Zoo, Nature Reserve and Amusement Park in your city
achievements.summary: Have a Park Maintenance Service, a zoo, a nature reserve and an amusement park in one city.

steps.text: Create separate zoo, nature reserve and amusement park areas, each with the matching main gate.
Build a @item{Park Maintenance Service} in the same city.

achievements.description: Have a park with all Amusement Park buildings built in it
achievements.summary: Build every amusement park building within one park area.

steps.text: Paint one amusement park area and place its main gate. Connect the gate to a road and the park buildings to paths.
Develop the amusement park to level 5 by meeting the visitor and entertainment targets shown in its information panel.

In the @mechanic{Amusement Park} building tab, place every park building inside that same area, including the side gate. The required buildings end before the decorative benches; props are unnecessary.

achievements.description: Have a park with all Nature Reserve buildings built in it
achievements.summary: Build every nature reserve building within one park area.

steps.text: Paint one nature reserve area and place its main gate. Connect the gate to a road and the park buildings to paths.
Include a shoreline within the park boundary so water-based attractions can be placed.
Develop the nature reserve to level 5 by meeting the visitor and entertainment targets shown in its information panel.

In the @mechanic{Nature Reserve} building tab, place every park building inside that same area, including the side gate. The required buildings end before the decorative benches; props are unnecessary. Place both fishing buildings beside the water.

achievements.description: Have 15 Sightseeing Bus lines
achievements.summary: Have 15 Sightseeing Bus lines.

steps.text: Build a @item{Sightseeing Bus Depot} and place sightseeing bus stops, then create 15 complete @mechanic{Sightseeing Bus} routes.

achievements.description: Level up an Industry Area up to Level 5
achievements.summary: Develop an Industry Area to level 5.

steps.text: Create an Industry Area and place the main building for its resource type.
Add extraction and processing buildings, then provide enough workers and transport access. Keep production running until the area panel awards level 5.

achievements.description: Build 10 Industry Areas
achievements.summary: Establish 10 Industry Areas.

steps.text: Paint 10 separate Industry Areas and place a matching industry main building inside each area.

achievements.description: Build five Oil Rigs
achievements.summary: Construct five Offshore Oil Drilling Platforms.

steps.text: Develop an oil Industry Area to level 5 to unlock the Offshore Oil Drilling Platform.
Place five Offshore Oil Drilling Platforms along the shoreline of an oil Industry Area.

achievements.description: Build all Unique Factories
achievements.summary: Construct every Unique Factory in one city.

steps.text: Develop farming, forestry, ore and oil Industry Areas to level 5 in the same city.

Open the Unique Factories category and construct every factory shown there. Check the entire category for buildings still locked or missing; reserve shoreline space for the factory that requires water access.

achievements.description: Deliver 1 000 000 units of Mail
achievements.summary: Deliver a cumulative 1,000,000 units of mail.

steps.text: Place Post Offices around the city and keep their road access clear. Add Post Sorting Facilities to expand mail deliveries, then leave the postal network running until 1,000,000 units have been delivered.

achievements.description: Build one of each road Toll Booth buildings
achievements.summary: Construct every type of road Toll Booth.

steps.text: In the road menu, place a one-way and a two-way Toll Booth, then place the large one-way and large two-way versions.

achievements.description: Build 10 Warehouse buildings
achievements.summary: Construct 10 warehouse buildings.

steps.text: Open the Warehouses category and place 10 buildings from that category. Industry-specific raw-material storage buildings do not count.

achievements.description: Have total number of 10 Dormitories
achievements.summary: Construct a total of 10 campus dormitories.

steps.text: Create a Campus Area with its administration building, then place 10 dormitories inside campus boundaries.

achievements.description: Have 15 000 students studying on campuses at the same time
achievements.summary: Have 15,000 students enrolled in Campus Areas simultaneously.

steps.text: Provide at least 15,000 student capacity across Campus Areas and enough elementary and high school places to supply eligible students.
Turn off competing ordinary universities and the Hadron Collider if present. Disable Schools Out and enable education policies that draw students into campuses.
Keep campuses accessible by public transport and expand the city until combined campus enrollment reaches 15,000.

achievements.description: Have one campus reach "Prestigious" in reputation
achievements.summary: Raise a Campus Area to Prestigious reputation.

steps.text: Expand a campus until its panel shows enough enrolled students and attractiveness for Prestigious reputation. Aim for at least 1,800 attractiveness and 16 academic works.
Fund academic staff and research grants, then let academic years finish until the campus receives Prestigious reputation.

achievements.description: Build all five varsity sports arenas on one campus in one city
achievements.summary: Construct all five varsity sports arenas within a single Campus Area.

steps.text: Create a campus with an administration building and enough free space. Place every arena in the Varsity Sports category inside that same campus boundary.

achievements.description: Build all Campus Area types with all of their respective campus buildings and faculties
achievements.summary: Construct every campus building and faculty for all three Campus Area types.

steps.text: Establish Trade School, Liberal Arts and University campuses. Develop each type to Prestigious reputation to unlock its full building selection.
For each campus type, open its complete building category and construct every building and faculty inside the matching Campus Area. Keep the completed campuses while finishing the other types.
Check each category without subcategory filters so no campus building is hidden.

achievements.description: Create 100 academic works
achievements.summary: Produce a total of 100 academic works.

steps.text: Develop Trade School, Liberal Arts and University campuses. Fund academic staff and research grants at each campus, then let academic years finish.
Keep the campus administration buildings while accumulating 100 academic works. Save before replacing a campus; reload that save if removing its administration building erases its works.

achievements.description: Cover one campus area upkeep cost entirely with tuition fees paid by students in a campus area with more than 5000 students
achievements.summary: Cover a campus’s entire upkeep with tuition while more than 5,000 students attend that campus.

steps.text: Concentrate more than 5,000 enrolled students in one campus. Provide enough campus capacity and turn off competing university education.
Disable Free Education and unnecessary campus spending, including research staff funding. Check the campus finances until tuition income covers the complete upkeep cost.

achievements.description: Farm 7 500 000 units of fish and sea plants.
achievements.summary: Produce fish and sea plants on farms until the combined total reaches 7,500,000 units.

steps.text: Place Fish Farms along clean water and keep them operating. Add Algae Farms and Seaweed Farms as they unlock, then keep farming until production reaches 7,500,000 units.

achievements.description: Catch 10 000 000 units of fish.
achievements.summary: Catch a cumulative 10,000,000 units of fish.

steps.text: Place Fishing Harbors on the shoreline and draw fishing routes that return to their harbor. Use the Fishing Industry view to match specialized harbors to the local fish.
Watch a fishing boat complete its route. Adjust the route so its hold fills without a long empty return, then add harbors and keep fishing until catches total 10,000,000 units.

achievements.description: Build one of each of the following transport hubs: Underground Metro-Intercity Bus Hub, Bus-Intercity Bus Hub, Train-Metro Hub, Metropolitan Airport, Bus-Metro Hub
achievements.summary: Construct the five Sunset Harbor transport hub types in one city.

steps.text: Open Transport Hubs and construct a Bus-Metro Hub, Metropolitan Airport, Train-Metro Hub, Bus-Intercity Bus Hub and Underground Metro-Intercity Bus Hub in the same city.

achievements.description: Transport 35 000 amount of citizens in trolleybuses.
achievements.summary: Carry a cumulative 35,000 citizens on trolleybuses.

steps.text: Build a Trolleybus Depot and connect trolleybus roads to the areas you want to serve. Create trolleybus lines with stops along those roads.
Serve busy journeys and keep the lines carrying passengers until trolleybuses have transported 35,000 citizens.

achievements.description: Transport 15 000 amount of citizens in passenger helicopters.
achievements.summary: Carry a cumulative 15,000 citizens in passenger helicopters.

steps.text: Place a Helicopter Depot and Helicopter Stops. Connect the depot and stops with Helicopter Pathways, then create passenger helicopter lines.
Link busy destinations and let the lines carry a cumulative 15,000 citizens.

achievements.description: Have 60 tourists visit the Aviation Club during one week.
achievements.summary: Draw 60 tourists to the Aviation Club within one week.

steps.text: Construct a standard Airport to unlock the Aviation Club, then place the club from the level-V Unique Buildings category.
Give tourists convenient public transport to the club and improve the city’s tourist appeal until the club records 60 tourist visits in a week.

achievements.description: Treat 20 000 000 m3 of waste water using the Inland Water Treatment Plants.
achievements.summary: Process a cumulative 20,000,000 m³ of sewage through Inland Water Treatment Plants.

steps.text: Build Inland Water Treatment Plants from the Water and Sewage menu and connect them to the city’s pipes. Shift sewage processing to these plants and keep enough treatment capacity operating until they have treated 20,000,000 m³.

achievements.description: Have an airport area reach level 3.
achievements.summary: Develop an Airport Area to level 3.

steps.text: Construct an Airport Area with a terminal, runway and aircraft stand, then keep the airport carrying passengers.
Add airport buildings that increase attractiveness. Reach 5,000 handled passengers and 1,000 airport attractiveness to obtain level 3.

achievements.description: Have 10 000 total passengers travel through an airport area.
achievements.summary: Handle a cumulative 10,000 passengers through an Airport Area.

steps.text: Keep an Airport Area operating with convenient public transport access. Improve city attractions to draw more tourists, and watch the airport’s total passenger counter until it reaches 10,000.

achievements.description: Build an airport area with a terminal, a runway and an aircraft stand.
achievements.summary: Construct a terminal, runway and aircraft stand within one Airport Area.

steps.text: Paint an Airport Area. Inside that boundary, place one airport terminal, one runway and one aircraft stand.

achievements.description: Build an airport area with an area of 25000 cells.
achievements.summary: Expand one Airport Area to 25,000 cells.

steps.text: Use Paint Airport Area to enlarge a single Airport Area until it covers 25,000 cells.

achievements.description: Set the airline ticket price slider to the maximum price.
achievements.summary: Set an airport airline’s ticket price to the maximum.

steps.text: Develop an Airport Area to level 3 and establish its airline.
Open the airport’s Airline section and move the ticket-price slider fully to the maximum.

achievements.description: Have 5 garbage service points reach their capacity limit.
achievements.summary: Have five pedestrian garbage service points use their full garbage-truck capacity simultaneously.

steps.text: Reach three garbage trucks per week in a pedestrian area to unlock the Small Garbage Service Point. Make a separate manual save before changing the city.

Extend a pedestrian area over the city and enable Deliver Everything. Place five Small Garbage Service Points on an isolated road, supply water and electricity, and wait for garbage to accumulate at the points.
Pause the game. Connect that road to a long, slow road and place about 20 landfills at its far end. Raise the garbage budget to 150%, then resume.
Let garbage trucks collect from the five service points. Keep the return journey long enough for each point to show 5/5 trucks simultaneously. Reload your manual save after the unlock.

achievements.description: Build 10 ice cream stand plazas in one pedestrian area.
achievements.summary: Construct 10 ice cream stand plazas inside a single pedestrian area.

steps.text: Open the Pedestrian Area Plazas category and place 10 ice cream stand plaza buildings inside one pedestrian area. Use the plaza building, not decorative ice cream stand props.

achievements.description: Have one pedestrian area focused on residential, one in commercial, and one in workplace zones.
achievements.summary: Have separate pedestrian areas focused on residential, commercial and workplace zones.

steps.text: Create three separate pedestrian areas and give each a service point.
Fill one with residential zoning, one with commercial zoning and one with offices. Use at least 150 zoned cells of the matching type in each, then check that each area shows its intended focus.

achievements.description: Earn ₡5,000,000 through investments.
achievements.summary: Earn a cumulative ₡5,000,000 in profit from selling investments.

steps.text: Buy investments through the Stock Exchange and sell when the investment panel shows a profit.
Continue profitable sales until total investment profit reaches ₡5,000,000. Check the Stock Exchange’s investment-profit progress; sale proceeds include the original stake, which is not profit.

achievements.description: Have at least ₡1 000 000 in cash. Put all of your available cash into investments, then don't sell any investments for one month.
achievements.summary: Invest all available cash from a balance of at least ₡1,000,000 and sell no investments for one in-game month.

steps.text: Build a stable surplus and a cash balance of at least ₡1,000,000. Pause and buy investments until the remaining balance cannot buy more shares.
Resume the simulation and hold every investment without selling for one full in-game month. If you sell early, establish a new all-in investment position and wait another full month without selling.

achievements.description: Have a bank building get flooded.
achievements.summary: Flood a bank building.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save, then construct a bank beside water.
Use the terrain tools to lower the ground so water floods the bank. Wait for the bank’s flooding warning and the unlock, then reload your saved city.

achievements.description: Transport ₡2,000,000 using cash transport vans in one week.
achievements.summary: Collect ₡2,000,000 by cash transport van within one week.

steps.text: Place banks so their service radii cover the city’s commercial zones, especially dense commercial areas.
Increase the Police and Banks budget to provide more cash vans. Expand commercial coverage until the banks’ combined weekly collection reaches ₡2,000,000.

achievements.description: Take a loan in order to make an investment.
achievements.summary: Use a loan to fund an investment purchase.

steps.text: Take a loan through Economy, then buy investments worth at least the loan amount.

achievements.description: Have total of 500 weekly guests to stay at hotels.
achievements.summary: Host a combined total of 500 hotel guests in one week.

steps.text: Build and develop hotels across the city. Match their locations to their popularity needs and lower room prices to attract guests.
Check Hotel Management for the combined weekly guest count and expand or improve hotels until the total reaches 500.

achievements.description: Organize three hotel events.
achievements.summary: Complete three hotel events.

steps.text: Develop hotels until five-star hotels are available. Select a five-star hotel and start an event from Hotel Events.
Let three events finish. Run events at three hotels simultaneously to shorten the wait, or host them one after another at one hotel.

achievements.description: Have the maximum possible number of guests stay at any 5 star hotel with at least 100 rooms.
achievements.summary: Achieve full guest occupancy at a five-star hotel offering at least 100 rooms.

steps.text: Choose a five-star hotel offering at least 100 rooms. Meet the hotel’s location needs until popularity reaches 100%.
Lower the room price to the minimum and wait for every guest space to fill.

achievements.description: Host and finish a motor race.
achievements.summary: Host and finish a motor race.

steps.text: Build a Race HQ, a route using Motor Race Tracks or Event Roads, pit garages and the required start and finish areas.
Choose a motor race at the venue and let the event finish.

achievements.description: Host a motor race on a route at least 5 km long.
achievements.summary: Host a motor race on a route at least 5 km long.

steps.text: Build a Race HQ, a route using Motor Race Tracks or Event Roads, pit garages and the required start and finish areas.
Extend the motor-race route to at least 5 km. Check its length in the venue panel, then host a motor race on the route.

achievements.description: Host a running race on a route at least 3 km long.
achievements.summary: Host a running race on a route at least 3 km long.

steps.text: Lay out an Event Road route at least 3 km long with the event’s start and finish areas. Choose a running race and host the event.

achievements.description: Host a cycling race on a route at least 4 km long.
achievements.summary: Host a cycling race on a route at least 4 km long.

steps.text: Lay out an Event Road route at least 4 km long with the event’s start and finish areas. Choose a cycling race and host the event.

achievements.description: Attract 1,000 spectators to one event.
achievements.summary: Attract 1,000 spectators to one event.

steps.text: Place spectator stands along an event route with enough space for at least 1,000 spectators.
Set a low event ticket price and host an event in a well-populated city until 1,000 spectators attend.

achievements.description: Host a parade at night.
achievements.summary: Host a parade at night.

steps.text: Create a parade route using Event Roads. Wait until the city is dark, then start a parade.

achievements.displayName: He Did What in This Cup?
achievements.description: Host a motor race at the highest event level.
achievements.summary: Host a motor race at the highest event level.

steps.text: Build a Race HQ, a route using Motor Race Tracks or Event Roads, pit garages and the required start and finish areas.
Select the highest motor-race level at the venue. Add enough pit garages to meet that level’s requirements, then start the race.

achievements.description: Host a parade at the highest event level.
achievements.summary: Host a parade at the highest event level.

steps.text: Build a parade route on Event Roads and select the highest parade level in its event controls. Meet the displayed event requirements and start the parade.
